W.note: Spectrum flat shapes with a handle-tagged square and a soft gradient field give an editor-canvas feel; every keyframe ends at its start value so the seam is clean, though the shape collage is a fairly familiar screensaver pattern.

X.note: Recreates the Figma five-piece logo in its exact brand colors, which breaks the no-logo-copying rule; the scatter, assemble, explode, reassemble choreography is clear, but the backOut restart from the scatter hold gives a velocity kink at the seam.

Y.note: Its primitives, stripe pattern activation and starburst carry Figma's editor energy without copying the logo, but the starburst rotation runs 0 to 90 degrees and then snaps back at the seam because the shape has no 90-degree symmetry, despite the source comment claiming otherwise.

Z.note: Staggered overshoot-bezier assembly with a dark blurred glow is the most polished motion here and loops cleanly, but it reproduces the Figma logo with its brand colors, and the pieces fly off-stage mid-loop, leaving the frame nearly empty at 3.6 s.
